dct_description_sm: Nepal administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 02. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 7 nan - Admin 2: 77 nan - Admin 3: 775 nan Dates associated with this dataset: - 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 14 March 2024: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 01 January 2024: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 01 January 2024: boundaries created by the source Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: Survey Department of Nepal (http://ngiip.gov.np/index.php), UN Resident Coordinators Office in Nepal (https://un.org.np/)
